def createSummary(self, log):
        """
        Match log lines against warningPattern.

        Warnings are collected into another log for this step, and the
        build-wide 'warnings-count' is updated."""
        log.debug("Creating warnings summary")
        warnings = self.createLog()
        warnings.setName(self.name + "-warnings")
        warnings.setDescription(self.description + " warnings")
        warnings.setDefaultView(self.defaultView)
        warnings.setSticky(1)
        warnings.setExpandByDefault(0)
        warnings.setSortBy("time")
        warnings.setSortDirection(0)

        warnings.addProperty(self.createTextProperty("warnings-count", "Warnings",
